name: Alesón (Spain)
description: Square blue flag with a yellow saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alesón (a plant and a jug on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Alesón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alesón arms — plant and jug on blue
cap of the crown of the arms
